outcome: quality of intraoperative and postoperative analgesia
cohort: 120 pregnant women of American Society of Anaesthesiologists physical status II posted for caesarean section at District Hospital, Bellary.
finding: 9mg of 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine with 15 micrograms of fentanyl provided the ideal balance between rapid onset of analgesia and minimal adverse effects for subarachnoid block in caesarean section.
